# Mez Systems Product Card 02

Product Card 02 is one programme with two deliberately sequenced phases.

## Phase A — Visual architecture

Round 02 replaces the rejected ten-direction gallery with one actual website-card architecture and four credible treatments. The shared architecture is a narrow portrait frame, approximately 320–360px wide, with a fixed information spine and a variable product-expression region.

- **C01 Editorial Portrait** is the recommended everyday card for product shelves, recommendations and collections.
- **C02 Full Field Portrait** is a bounded focal treatment and the only treatment that may request one Living Core per viewport.
- **C03 System Index** is the dense treatment for catalogues, comparisons and product UI.
- **C04 Product Pack** is commerce or launch media, not a universal card shell.

Light and dark are allocated by role. Repeated light shelves use white on the canonical F8 canvas. A focal component may use charcoal on light or white on charcoal. Dark rooms use `#171715`, `#1B1B19` and `#252523`, not pure black.

## Phase B — Website component system

Held until `H-EXP-04A-CARD-VISUAL-DIRECTION` locks the architecture and treatment allocation. Phase B will build real website components for discovery, feature placements, pricing, checkout, bundle offers, upsells and mobile sticky summaries, including responsive anatomy, commerce data, accessibility and complete interaction states.

This package is visual research. It has no production authority and does not change pricing, Stripe, product registry, homepage, Figma or consumer code.
